help.step1Text: Tap the camera button at the bottom of the screen and fit the whole sign in the frame. You can also choose a photo from your gallery.
help.step2Text: The position comes from the phone's GPS. If it is off, tap “Adjust” and move the map to put the marker on the sign.
help.step3Text: Give it a title, choose tags, add a comment if you like. The sign appears on the map straight away.
help.suggestedAutomaticallySignsPosition: It is suggested automatically from the sign's position. If it is wrong, remove it like any other tag.
